interpretation.name: CalibrateNutrunnerBeforeLine2Use
interpretation.goal: Calibrate the shared nutrunner NR7 before line 2 uses it to tighten the F30 variant fasteners.
constraints: Calibration of NR7 must be completed before NR7 is used for tightening on line 2.
No service in the Local Cloud provides tool calibration, so the calibration cannot be planned with the available services.
Any later tightening on line 2 must follow E1-E6: reservation, transport to st2 by agvexecutor, program obtained via get-program, evaluation, recording and release.
interpretation.horizon: Before the next use of NR7 on line 2 (station st2, variant F30).

findings.message: requested capabilities not exposed by the Local Cloud: ['calibrate-tool']
